episode_summary: Greg Roeder shares his journey from being an invisible agent to a top producer by leveraging community events and targeted content. He emphasizes the importance of building genuine relationships and creating niche-specific content to attract clients without traditional advertising. The episode provides actionable insights for agents looking to balance work and personal life while growing their business sustainably.
